answer: Wharf-dune relic delivery-commitment bond: each agent posts 70, registers a key-signed relic at the wharf, then hauls it across a dune route, stamped at three dune checkpoints by epoch close. The wharf weighs it and checks its serial; a missing stamp, wrong weight, or reused relic burns it. First 34, kth 34+6(k-1), 1000th 6,028; 1,000 fakes pay 3,101,000 in all. Rented couriers fail: key must match the relic. Honest agents pay 34 once.
